title: Write a city's ratio rules as linear rows
heading: Every Rule Is One Linear Row, and a Ratio Is Multiplied Out Before It Is Written
cases: a split with every mode under its share is allowed, and one with a mode far above it is refused
the share is of the whole total, the mode's own spend included
every mode is held to the share, not only the first one listed
a pair (a, b, ratio) bounds a from below by ratio times b, not the other way round
multiplying the ratio out puts the ratio on the second mode's side, so a ratio below 1 allows the first mode less than the second
